title: Every Grothendieck derived object has an alpha-compact rank
statement: For every object U of the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with derived coproducts [lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts], there exists a regular alpha in universe v for which U is alpha-compact [def-sfb-alpha-compact-object].

source.place: Krause (2001), Corollary after Lemma 5 page 125; Localization theory 6.3; Neeman Theorem 0.2.

proof.text: Choose perfect well-generators G and define S to be the union of the regular alpha-compact classes.

The proved API gives repletion, zero and shift closure. For an extension choose a common regular bound above the two outer ranks and the eventual-smallness bound, then use middle-vertex closure of that bounded class.

For an arbitrary v-small coproduct, choose each summand rank and a common regular cardinal larger than all those ranks and the indexing set. Monotonicity and bounded coproduct closure make the sum alpha-compact.
Each generator belongs to S using G itself as the small/G4 witness. The localizing generation clause forces S to contain every object, providing the required rank.
